1.why: Token verification enforces record.sessionId === session.id, binding each reset token to the session that requested it.

2.why: Session binding rejects tokens from other sessions and successful verification deletes the record, so a code cannot work for anyone else.

3.why: Password change only flips mfaVerified to false; session records and cookies are never invalidated, so existing sessions continue to work.

4.why: HTTPS is enforced via TLS server, 308 redirect, and HSTS, but the TLS version is left to Bun defaults rather than pinned to the latest.

5.why: Reset tokens are stored as SHA-256 digests and passwords as Argon2id hashes, but MFA codes are kept as plaintext static values.

6.why: No email is sent at all; the simulated recovery returns the raw token in the JSON response and prints it in the on-page Logs panel.

7.why: Contact, token, code, and password inputs are strictly validated with regexes and JSON schema checks, and all rendering uses textContent, though the code validates/rejects rather than sanitizes.

8.why: The only redirect is hardcoded to the HTTPS origin and SPA navigation uses fixed internal routes, with no user-controlled redirect targets.

9.why: No email templates exist; every displayed message is a static string rendered via textContent under a nonce-based CSP, so no user input becomes HTML or script.

10.why: Tokens and MFA codes are deliberately written to the client-side Logs panel ('ACADEMIC TEST ONLY'), even though server error pages are generic.

11.why: Passwords are Argon2id-hashed with an env-supplied initial hash, but the MFA codes '482913' and '741852' are hardcoded directly in the source.

12.why: No default password exists and login is impossible until a hash is set, though the static hardcoded MFA codes act as deterministic secondary credentials.

13.why: All sensitive endpoints use recordAttempt with limits and 60-second lockouts, but throttling is per-session and can be bypassed by clearing cookies.

14.why: The recovery endpoint returns the identical generic message whether the contact is valid or not, revealing nothing about account existence.

15.why: Reset tokens are 256-bit CSPRNG hex values, session-bound, single-use, and expire after 10 minutes.
